title: Nourishing Thai Spaghetti Gaeng Curry
description: A fermented and shaggy Thai dish featuring spaghetti in a gaeng curry sauce, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and incorporates tempering chocolate for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until it is al dente.
In a blender or food processor, combine the gaeng curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and fermented soybeans, and blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the blended curry sauce, stirring constantly.
Bring the curry sauce to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval until smooth.
Stir the melted chocolate into the curry sauce and continue to simmer for another 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked spaghetti and add it to the curry sauce, tossing to combine.
Season the spaghetti with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped Thai basil and serve immediately.
